name: Hare Doki Doki Bunkasai
source:
Main character is an ordinary high school student. Culture festival approaches, and he is forced to be its executive committee member. His childhood friend assists him with preparation. It may be an opportunity for him to get along with a previously unreachable classmate. Who will he spend this culture festival with? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名普通的高中生。文化祭即將到來，他被迫成為執行委員。青梅竹馬幫助他進行準備工作。這也許是他和以前遙不可及的同學拉近關係的機會。他會和誰一起度過這個文化祭呢？

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]］
